html:
On 7 June 1905 the Norwegian parliament declared the union with Sweden dissolved. Norway became a fully independent kingdom.

Under the union of 1814 Norway had its own constitution and parliament but shared a king and foreign policy with Sweden. The spark was a quarrel over separate Norwegian consuls abroad, needed for its large merchant fleet. A referendum that August showed all but a handful of voters for the break.

For a few weeks war seemed possible, but the two sides negotiated, and Sweden accepted at Karlstad. A Danish prince was elected king and took the name Haakon VII. The peaceful break ended Sweden-Norway and is often given as a model of a negotiated separation.
sum: On 7 June 1905 the Norwegian parliament declared the union with Sweden dissolved. Norway became a fully independent kingdom.
